title: ekky task result
description: What the headless agent returns for one attempt at one task. The dispatcher writes it to result.json, renders result.md from it, and sets the task status from the status field.

status.description: done: every unit committed on the local branch. failed: a step broke and could not be recovered; partial work is WIP-committed. needs-input: a core ambiguity would invalidate more than half the units; nothing built past the point it was found.

summary.description: One line: what was built, or why it stopped.

decisions.description: Every fork taken by pick-and-flag. Empty when there were none.

fork.description: The question the task record left open, in one sentence.

rejected.description: The branch not taken, stated at its strongest.

why.description: One clause: the reason the chosen branch wins.

deviations.description: Where the built thing differs from the intent card, in prose. Empty string when it matches.

verify.description: How the reviewer checks it works: the commands to run, the screen to open, the query to fire.

question.description: Only on needs-input: the single question whose answer unblocks the task, with the options and their consequences. Empty string otherwise.
